body.message:
Apologies for the delay.

Regarding the payment terms, the first month’s rent, final month’s rent, and security deposit are required to be paid upfront to confirm the booking. The remaining monthly payments can then be made on a month-to-month basis.

As the September rental has been calculated for 8 days, the payment required to secure the booking will include:

September rent for 8 days
Full October rental
Final month’s rental
Security deposit

Once these payments are completed, we can proceed with placing and confirming the booking.

However I will prepare the contract the contract and share the details with you by tomorrow
